description: Survey of ~80K PhD holders in the US workforce. Unlike IPEDS, this separates US citizens from permanent residents.

permanent_resident.description: Green card holder — counted as domestic in IPEDS

key_finding: 28.1% of the US-based domestic PhD workforce (those IPEDS calls US citizen or permanent resident) are actually foreign-born: 22% naturalized citizens + 7% green card holders. Only 63.5% of PhD holders in the US are native-born Americans.
ipeds_comparison: IPEDS groups native citizens + naturalized citizens + permanent residents into one category called US citizen or permanent resident. The SDR shows this hides a significant foreign-born population.
